items.example: The root supplies the motion in transition.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供转变一词中的动感。

items.example: It names the crossing rather than the destination.
items.exampleCN: 它命名跨越本身，而非目的地。

items.meaning: a passing from one state to another
items.meaningCN: 从一种状态到另一种的过渡
items.example: The transition took two generations.
items.exampleCN: 这次过渡用了两代人的时间。

items.example: Transitional housing shelters new arrivals.
items.exampleCN: 过渡住房收留新到的人。

latinEntries.structure: transire, transii, transitum (Latin verb, 'to go across')

definition_zh: 使工业化；使产业化；实现工业化
definition_en: to develop industry in a place, or to change production so that it is carried out by machines and factories
core_image: 河岸上的水磨坊被拆掉，厂房、烟囱与传送带依次立起，水面倒映着新的屋顶
scene: 河谷里的老磨坊被拆掉，取而代之的是第一座纱厂。Governments tried to industrialize the region without displacing its farmers.
sceneCN: 这里 industrialize 指「在一个地区建立并发展工业」（第 1 个义项：使某地工业化）；句意为政府试图在不迫使农民离开的情况下让这个地区工业化。图中可辨识物件：拆掉的水磨坊、纱厂、烟囱、传送带。

pos.zh: 实现工业化；变得工业化

derivatives.zh: 工业化的；已实现工业化的

senses.title: Build industry in a place
senses.definition: to develop factories and manufacturing in a region or country
senses.definitionCN: 在一个地区或国家发展工厂与制造业
senses.example: Governments tried to industrialize the region without displacing its farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 政府试图在不迫使农民离开的情况下让这个地区工业化。
senses.why: the verb is the adjective industrial turned into an action, so it means to make a place industrial.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词由形容词「工业的」转为动作，意思是使一个地方变得有工业。

senses.title: Shift an economy to manufacturing
senses.definition: to move the balance of an economy from farming and extraction toward manufacturing
senses.definitionCN: 使经济重心从农业与采掘转向制造业
senses.example: The country industrialized by moving labour from fields to mills.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家通过把劳动力从田地转向工厂实现了工业化。
senses.why: industry in the economic sense is a whole sector, so the verb can name a structural change rather than a single factory.
senses.whyCN: 经济意义上的工业是整个部门，因此这个动词可以指结构变化，而不只是建一座工厂。

senses.title: Equip a craft with machines
senses.definition: to replace hand methods in a trade with machines and a factory system
senses.definitionCN: 用机器与工厂制度取代一门行业中的手工方法
senses.example: Weaving was industrialized before baking was.
senses.exampleCN: 织布比烤面包更早被工业化。
senses.why: a craft becomes industrial when its steps are divided among machines and workers under one roof.
senses.whyCN: 当一道手艺的各个步骤被分给同一屋檐下的机器与工人时，它就工业化了。

senses.title: Become industrial
senses.definition: to undergo industrialization without an external agent
senses.definitionCN: 在没有外部施动者的情况下经历工业化
senses.example: The valley industrialized quickly once the railway arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 铁路一到，这个河谷很快就工业化了。
senses.why: English verbs often work both ways, so the same form describes the place changing by itself.
senses.whyCN: 英语动词常可双向使用，同一形式也能描述一个地方自行发生的变化。

senses.title: Scale farming up to industry
senses.titleCN: 把农业放大到工业规模
senses.definition: to apply machines, chemicals and large-scale organization to farming
senses.definitionCN: 把机械、化学品与大规模组织应用于农业
senses.example: They industrialized dairy farming with milking machines and sheds of a thousand head.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用挤奶机与千头规模的牛棚把乳业工业化。
senses.why: the word spreads from factories to any production organized on factory lines, including food.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从工厂扩散到任何按工厂方式组织的生产，包括食物。

senses.title: Build by prefabricated methods
senses.definition: to construct buildings or goods from standard factory-made parts
senses.definitionCN: 用工厂制造的标准部件建造房屋或产品
senses.example: The firm industrialized housing with prefabricated wall panels.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司用预制墙板把住宅建造工业化。
senses.why: if the parts are made in a factory and assembled on site, the process itself has been industrialized.
senses.whyCN: 如果部件在工厂制造、在现场组装，这个过程本身就已经工业化。

senses.title: Undergo the Industrial Revolution
senses.definition: to pass through the historical period in which machine production transformed society
senses.definitionCN: 经历机器生产改造社会的那个历史时期
senses.example: Britain industrialized first and exported the model.
senses.exampleCN: 英国最先经历工业革命，并把这一模式输出。
senses.why: historians use the verb as shorthand for a century-long transformation, not for one decision.
senses.whyCN: 历史学者用这个动词作为长达一个世纪的转型的简称，而非指某一项决定。

senses.title: Make a service run like a factory
senses.titleCN: 使服务业像工厂一样运转
senses.definition: to reorganize a service around standardized, high-volume routines
senses.definitionCN: 围绕标准化、大批量的流程重组一项服务
senses.example: Critics say the hospital has been industrialized into a production line.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者说这家医院已被工业化成一条生产线。
senses.why: the extended sense borrows the factory image to criticize services that treat people as units of output.
senses.whyCN: 这一引申义借工厂意象，批评把当成人按产出单位处理的服务。

intro.en: Industrialize is industrial plus the verb suffix -ize. Industrial rests on Latin industria 'diligence, activity', and the verb was formed in the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: industrialize 由 industrial 加动词后缀 -ize 构成。industrial 源于拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」，这个动词在 19 世纪形成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Industria meant 'diligence, purposeful activity'. Its deeper origin is not established; the link sometimes drawn to a compound of indu- and struere 'to build' is a hypothesis, not a proven derivation.
items.cn: industria 意为「勤勉、有目的的活动」。其更深来源未得到证明；有人把它分析为 indu- 与 struere「建造」的组合，那只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: French industrie carried the word into English, where industry first meant diligent effort before it came to mean a sector of production.
items.cn: 法语 industrie 把这个词带入英语，industry 最初指勤勉努力，后来才指生产部门。

items.en: By the eighteenth century industry named manufacturing and trade as a whole, and industrial was coined as its adjective.
items.cn: 到 18 世纪，industry 已指整个制造业与贸易，industrial 则作为它的形容词被造出。

items.en: The verb suffix came through French from Greek -izein, meaning 'to make, to act upon', and it turns adjectives and nouns into verbs.
items.cn: 这个动词后缀经法语来自希腊 -izein，意为「使、对……行事」，它把形容词与名词变成动词。

items.en: Industrialize appeared in the nineteenth century as factories spread, first describing places and trades, later any process organized on factory lines.
items.cn: industrialize 在 19 世纪工厂扩散之际出现，最初描述地方与行业，后来也描述任何按工厂方式组织的过程。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin origin of industria is unsettled, and the earliest use of the English verb is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：industria 在拉丁语之前的来源尚无定论，这个英语动词的最早使用也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same stem that are easily confused by meaning; group two holds verbs of economic change.
note.cn: 第一组是同出这一词干、因词义而极易混淆的词；第二组是表示经济变化的动词。

entries.definition: Of industry or of manufacturing; it describes the state, while industrialize describes the change.
entries.definitionCN: 工业的、制造业的；描述状态，而工业化动词描述变化。

entries.definition: The process or result of becoming industrial; the verb names the act, the noun the whole change.
entries.definitionCN: 变得工业化的过程或结果；动词指行为，名词指整体变化。

entries.definition: An owner or manager of large industry, not someone who industrializes a place.
entries.definitionCN: 大工业的所有者或管理者，而不是使某地工业化的人。

entries.definition: Diligent and hard-working; it keeps the older sense of industry as effort and has nothing to do with factories.
entries.definitionCN: 勤勉刻苦；保留了 industry 较早的「努力」义，与工厂无关。

entries.definition: To replace human or animal power with machines; narrower than industrialize, which also implies factories and a sector.
entries.definitionCN: 用机器取代人力或畜力；比工业化窄，后者还含工厂与部门之意。

entries.definition: To bring something up to date in technology or organization; it can be done without industry.
entries.definitionCN: 在技术或组织上使某物现代化；不必涉及工业。

entries.definition: To improve an economy or place in any direction; industrialization is one path of development.
entries.definitionCN: 使经济或地方朝任何方向改善；工业化是发展的一条路径。

entries.definition: To make goods in quantity, especially in a factory; it describes output rather than the transformation of a place.
entries.definitionCN: 大量制造商品，尤指在工厂；描述产出而非一个地方的转型。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Industrial plus the suffix meaning to make: to make a place industrial.
normal.cn: 工业的加表示「使」的后缀：使一个地方具有工业。

normal.en: The pair industrial and industrialize differs by state and change.
normal.cn: 工业的与工业化这一对，差别在状态与变化。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as newly industrializing country mark the process in progress.
normal.cn: 新兴工业化国家这类固定搭配标示正在发生的过程。

normal.en: The same verb covers farming and housing once they are organized like factories.
normal.cn: 一旦农业与住宅按工厂方式组织，同一个动词也适用于它们。

normal.en: Industrious is the old sense of effort and is not a synonym of industrial.
normal.cn: 勤勉一词保留了较早的努力义，并不是工业的同义词。

abstract.en: Picture a water wheel replaced by a belt that never stops moving.
abstract.cn: 想象一只水轮被一条永不停歇的皮带取代。

abstract.en: Picture a village clock replaced by a factory whistle.
abstract.cn: 想象村庄的钟声被工厂汽笛取代。

abstract.en: Picture a pair of hands replaced by a row of identical machines.
abstract.cn: 想象一双双手被一排一模一样的机器取代。

examples.en: The state subsidized loans to industrialize the interior.
examples.cn: 该州补贴贷款，以推动内陆工业化。

examples.en: Countries that industrialized late could import both machines and designs.
examples.cn: 后实现工业化的国家可以同时进口机器与设计。

examples.en: The cooperative industrialized its packing house to meet export standards.
examples.cn: 合作社把包装厂工业化，以符合出口标准。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「工业的（industrial）+ 使……化（-ize）」——使一个地方长出工厂，就是工业化

root: 拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」→ 法语 industrie → 英语 industry、industrial；加希腊来源的动词后缀 -ize 构成 industrialize。industria 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act of building: factories in a region, a whole economy turned toward manufacturing, a craft rebuilt around machines, a place changing by itself, farming and housing organized on factory lines, the historical revolution, and a service criticized for running like a production line.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种建设展开：在一个地区建工厂、整个经济转向制造业、一门手艺围绕机器重建、一个地方自行改变、农业与住宅按工厂方式组织、历史性的工业革命，以及被批评为像生产线一样运转的服务业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mill replaced by a factory, with a chimney rising where the water wheel stood.
core.cn: 核心意象：磨坊被工厂取代，烟囱在水轮原来的位置竖起。

branches.en: BUILD: the base sense, bringing factories into a place.
branches.cn: 建设：基础义，把工厂带进一个地方。

branches.en: SHIFT AND REMAKE: a whole economy changes sector, and a single trade changes its tools.
branches.cn: 转移与重造：整个经济换部门，单门手艺换工具。

branches.en: SELF-CHANGE: the place can industrialize without anyone industrializing it.
branches.cn: 自行改变：地方可以在无人施动的情况下自己工业化。

branches.en: SCALE: farms and building sites adopt factory methods and standard parts.
branches.cn: 规模：农场与工地采用工厂方法与标准部件。

branches.en: HISTORY AND CRITIQUE: the century-long revolution, and the factory image applied to services.
branches.cn: 历史与批评：长达一个世纪的革命，以及把工厂意象套用到服务业。

intro.en: Industrialize is a Latin noun turned into an adjective and then into a verb, so three layers can be read in it.
intro.cn: industrialize 是一个拉丁名词先变形容词、再变动词的结果，因此可以读出三层结构。

latinIntro.en: Latin industria gives industry and industrial; the suffix -ize, from Greek through French, adds the sense of making or causing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 industria 给出 industry 与 industrial；后缀 -ize 经法语来自希腊语，增添「使、致」的意思。

items.example: The root first meant effort before it meant manufacturing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根先指努力，后来才指制造业。

items.example: It turns the noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把名词变成形容词。

items.example: The industrial belt runs along the river.
items.exampleCN: 工业带沿河延伸。

items.example: It turns the adjective into a verb of change.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成表变化的动词。

items.example: They industrialized the port in ten years.
items.exampleCN: 他们在十年内使这个港口工业化。

items.example: It names the whole change rather than one act.
items.exampleCN: 它命名整体变化，而非单个行为。

items.example: Industrialization drew workers into the cities.
items.exampleCN: 工业化把工人吸进城市。

items.example: It builds the older adjective of effort.
items.exampleCN: 它构成较早的、表示努力的那一形容词。

items.example: An industrious apprentice finished early.
items.exampleCN: 一个勤勉的学徒提前完工。

definition_zh: 工业社会（以工业生产为主导的社会形态）
definition_en: a society whose economy and daily life are organized around manufacturing industry
core_image: 厂房、工人宿舍、铁路与钟楼围成一座自足的城市，汽笛决定一天的节奏
scene: 老照片里，上班的人流在天未亮时涌向厂门，汽笛一响整条街都醒了。Industrial society brought the factory clock into everyday life.
sceneCN: 这里 industrial society 指「以工业生产为主导组织起来的社会」（第 1 个义项：以制造业为基础的社会）；句意为工业社会把工厂的时钟带进了日常生活。图中可辨识物件：厂房、宿舍、铁路、钟楼、涌向厂门的人流。

senses.title: A society built on manufacturing
senses.titleCN: 以制造业为基础的社会
senses.definition: a society whose wealth, work and daily rhythm centre on factory production
senses.definitionCN: 财富、工作与日常节奏都以工厂生产为中心的社会
senses.example: Industrial society brought the factory clock into everyday life.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会把工厂的时钟带进了日常生活。
senses.why: the phrase simply names a society of the industrial kind, with industry as its organizing centre.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语直接命名一种工业类型的社会，以工业为其组织中心。

senses.title: A stage in development typology
senses.titleCN: 发展阶段类型中的一个阶段
senses.definition: one stage in the classification that runs from agrarian to industrial to post-industrial societies
senses.definitionCN: 从农业社会到工业社会再到后工业社会的分类中的一个阶段
senses.example: Sociologists placed the country at the industrial stage of the typology.
senses.exampleCN: 社会学者把这个国家归入类型学中的工业阶段。
senses.why: a type becomes a stage when societies are arranged along a single line of development.
senses.whyCN: 当社会被排在同一条发展线上时，一个类型就变成一个阶段。

senses.title: A concept in early sociology
senses.titleCN: 早期社会学的一个概念
senses.definition: the model of modern society that nineteenth-century sociology built around industry and its division of labour
senses.definitionCN: 19 世纪社会学围绕工业及其分工所建立的现代社会模型
senses.example: Industrial society was the central concept of the discipline's founders.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会是该学科创立者们的核心概念。
senses.why: early sociologists needed a name for the new order they saw replacing agrarian life.
senses.whyCN: 早期社会学者需要给眼前取代农业生活的新秩序一个名字。

senses.title: Its class and work structure
senses.definition: the social order of wage labour, employers and classes that factory production creates
senses.definitionCN: 工厂生产所造成的雇佣劳动、雇主与阶级的社会秩序
senses.example: Industrial society produced a large working class and a small owning class.
senses.exampleCN: 工业社会产生了一个庞大的工人阶级与一个很小的有产阶层。
senses.why: the factory gathers many workers under one employer, and that arrangement shapes the whole class structure.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把许多工人聚到同一个雇主之下，这一安排塑造了整个阶级结构。

senses.title: Its characteristic institutions
senses.definition: the school, the bureaucracy, the clock and the city that industrial organization requires
senses.definitionCN: 工业组织所需要的学校、官僚机构、时钟与城市
senses.example: Compulsory schooling was an institution of industrial society.
senses.exampleCN: 义务教育是工业社会的一项制度。
senses.why: industry needs punctual, literate, disciplined workers, so it builds institutions that produce them.
senses.whyCN: 工业需要守时、识字、守纪律的工人，因此它建起生产这类人的制度。

senses.title: A historical period
senses.definition: the era, roughly from the late eighteenth to the late twentieth century, when industry dominated
senses.definitionCN: 大约从 18 世纪末到 20 世纪末、工业占主导的时代
senses.example: The photographs document industrial society at its height.
senses.exampleCN: 这些照片记录了工业社会的鼎盛时期。
senses.why: a social type with a beginning and an end becomes a period that historians can date.
senses.whyCN: 一个有始有终的社会类型会成为历史学者可以断代的时期。

senses.title: The contrast with post-industrial society
senses.definition: the older order against which service-based and knowledge-based societies define themselves
senses.definitionCN: 以服务业与知识为基础的社会用来定义自身的那个较早秩序
senses.example: Post-industrial society is defined by what industrial society was not.
senses.exampleCN: 后工业社会是靠工业社会「不是」什么来定义的。
senses.why: once a successor type is named, the older phrase becomes a benchmark rather than a description.
senses.whyCN: 一旦后继类型被命名，较早的短语就成为基准，而不只是描述。

senses.title: A target of ecological critique
senses.definition: the order criticized for treating nature as a supply of inputs and for generating risk
senses.definitionCN: 被批评为把自然当作投入来源并制造风险的那种秩序
senses.example: Green theorists blame industrial society for the climate crisis.
senses.exampleCN: 绿色理论家把气候危机归咎于工业社会。
senses.why: critics turn the descriptive phrase into an accusation by attaching pollution and risk to its way of producing.
senses.whyCN: 批评者把污染与风险归到它的生产方式上，从而把描述性短语变成指控。

intro.en: Industrial is built on Latin industria 'diligence, activity'; society comes from Latin societas 'companionship, association', from socius 'ally'. The phrase belongs to nineteenth-century social thought. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: industrial 由拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」构成；society 来自拉丁 societas「同伴关系、结社」，其词根为 socius「盟友」。这个短语属于 19 世纪的社会思想。年代均为约数。

items.en: Industria meant 'diligence, purposeful activity'; its deeper origin is unsettled, and the derivation sometimes offered from indu- plus struere 'to build' is a hypothesis.
items.cn: industria 意为「勤勉、有目的的活动」；其更深来源尚无定论，有人提出它由 indu- 与 struere「建造」构成，那只是假说。

items.en: Socius meant 'companion, ally', and societas named the bond or association among such people. The deeper origin of socius is not established.
items.cn: socius 意为「同伴、盟友」，societas 指这些人之间的纽带或结社。socius 的更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: Industry shifted from diligence to manufacturing in the eighteenth century, and industrial was coined to describe it.
items.cn: industry 在 18 世纪从「勤勉」转向「制造业」，industrial 随之被造出来描述它。

items.en: Society entered English through French and came to mean an organized collectivity, not merely company.
items.cn: society 经法语进入英语，逐渐指有组织的集体，而不只是作伴。

items.en: Social thinkers of the nineteenth century paired the two words to name the new order built on factories, wage labour and cities.
items.cn: 19 世纪的社会思想家把这两个词配对，用来命名建立在工厂、雇佣劳动与城市之上的新秩序。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origins and first date): the pre-Latin origins of industria and socius are reconstructions, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：industria 与 socius 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构形式；这一确切短语的最早使用没有精确记录。

note.en: Group one holds industrial compounds and related words that look alike; group two holds other labels for modern social orders.
note.cn: 第一组是外形相近的工业类组合词与相关词；第二组是对现代社会秩序的其他称谓。

entries.definition: The economic order of privately owned industry and wage labour; it names the system, while industrial society names the society.
entries.definitionCN: 私有工业与雇佣劳动的经济秩序；命名的是制度，而工业社会命名的是社会。

entries.definition: A society that has completed industrialization, stressing the outcome rather than the social type.
entries.definitionCN: 已完成工业化的社会，强调结果而非社会类型。

entries.definition: The system of industrial organization, or belief in it as the proper basis of society.
entries.definitionCN: 工业组织的制度，或对其作为社会适当基础的信念。

entries.definition: The period of rapid mechanization that produced industrial society; the phrase names the change, not the resulting order.
entries.definitionCN: 带来工业社会的快速机械化时期；命名的是变化，而非形成后的秩序。

entries.definition: A society whose economy centres on services and knowledge rather than manufacturing.
entries.definitionCN: 经济以服务业与知识而非制造业为中心的社会。

entries.definition: A society organized around farming and land ownership, the type industrial society replaced.
entries.definitionCN: 围绕农业与土地所有权组织的社会，是工业社会所取代的类型。

entries.definition: A broad label for contemporary social orders; it includes industry but also politics, science and culture.
entries.definitionCN: 对当代社会秩序的宽泛称谓；包含工业，也包含政治、科学与文化。

entries.definition: A society of large-scale, impersonal organization and mass culture; it overlaps with industrial society but stresses conformity.
entries.definitionCN: 以大规模、非人格化组织与大众文化为特征的社会；与工业社会重叠，但强调趋同。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Industrial describes the economy, society the people, so the phrase is a society organized around industry.
normal.cn: 工业的描述经济，社会的指人群，因此这个短语是围绕工业组织起来的社会。

normal.en: The typology runs agrarian, industrial, post-industrial in that order.
normal.cn: 类型学按农业、工业、后工业的顺序排列。

normal.en: The factory clock, the school and the city are its institutions.
normal.cn: 工厂时钟、学校与城市是它的制度。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as mature industrial society and transition to an industrial society mark the historical senses.
normal.cn: 成熟的工业社会、向工业社会过渡这类固定搭配标出历史义。

normal.en: The phrase is descriptive, but critics turn it into an accusation.
normal.cn: 这个短语本为描述，但批评者会把它变成指控。

abstract.en: Picture a town whose bell tower has been replaced by a whistle nobody can ignore.
abstract.cn: 想象一座小镇的钟楼被一只谁也躲不开的汽笛取代。

abstract.en: Picture a classroom, a factory and a railway station built from the same grey brick.
abstract.cn: 想象教室、工厂与车站都用同一种灰砖建成。

abstract.en: Picture a river that carries goods instead of fish.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河里运的是货物而不是鱼。

examples.en: Industrial society expanded schooling to produce literate workers.
examples.cn: 工业社会扩张学校教育，以培养识字工人。

examples.en: The novel describes industrial society through one factory town.
examples.cn: 这部小说通过一座工厂城镇描写工业社会。

examples.en: Critics of industrial society pointed to pollution and alienation.
examples.cn: 工业社会的批评者指出了污染与疏离。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「工业的（industrial）+ 社会（society）」——工厂与汽笛组织起来的社会，就是工业社会

root: 拉丁 industria「勤勉、活动」→ industrial；拉丁 socius「同伴」→ societas「结社」→ society。两词在 19 世纪社会思想中固定连用。两词的更深来源均不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one kind of society: the factory-centred order, its place in a typology, its role in early sociology, its class structure, its institutions, its historical period, its contrast with the post-industrial, and its use as an ecological accusation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种社会展开：以工厂为中心的秩序、它在类型学中的位置、它在早期社会学中的角色、它的阶级结构、它的制度、它的历史时期、它与后工业的对照，以及它作为生态指控的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a factory gate, a whistle, a school and a station all set within one grey town.
core.cn: 核心意象：厂门、汽笛、学校与车站都装在同一座灰色城镇里。

branches.en: CENTRE: the base sense, a society whose working life turns around manufacturing.
branches.cn: 中心：基础义，工作生活围绕制造业运转的社会。

branches.en: PLACE IN TIME: a stage in the typology and, later, a dated historical period.
branches.cn: 时间中的位置：类型学中的一个阶段，后来又成为一个可断代的时期。

branches.en: MODEL AND CLASSES: a concept built by early sociology, and the wage-labour order it described.
branches.cn: 模型与阶级：早期社会学建立的概念，以及它所描述的雇佣劳动秩序。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS: the clock, the school and the city that industry requires.
branches.cn: 制度：工业所需的时钟、学校与城市。

branches.en: AFTERWARD AND AGAINST: the benchmark set by post-industrial society, and the ecological charge laid against it.
branches.cn: 之后与反对：后工业社会树立的基准，以及针对它的生态指控。

intro.en: The phrase joins an adjective of industry to a noun of association, and both halves carry productive pieces.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个工业形容词与一个结社名词连在一起，两半都带着能产的构词成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin industria gives industry, industrial and industrialization; Latin socius gives society, social and associate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 industria 给出 industry、industrial 与 industrialization；拉丁 socius 给出 society、social 与 associate。

items.example: The root first named effort, then manufacturing.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根先指努力，后来指制造业。

items.example: It forms the adjective of industry.
items.exampleCN: 它构成工业的形容词。

items.example: Industrial output doubled in a decade.
items.exampleCN: 工业产出在十年内翻番。

items.example: The root names people bound to one another.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指彼此联结的人。

items.example: It builds the noun of association.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示结社的名词。

items.example: Society changes faster than its laws.
items.exampleCN: 社会的变化快于它的法律。

items.example: It builds the adjective from the noun of association.
items.exampleCN: 它由结社名词构成形容词。

items.example: Social rules vary between towns.
items.exampleCN: 社会规则因城镇而异。

items.example: It names the industrial order as a system.
items.exampleCN: 它把工业秩序命名为一种制度。

items.meaning: the industrial system or its doctrine
items.example: Industrialism reshaped the family.
items.exampleCN: 工业制度重塑了家庭。

definition_zh: 农业社会（以农业生产为主导组织起来的社会）
definition_en: a society whose wealth, work and daily life are organized around farming
core_image: 田块、水渠、谷仓与村落围成一片以季节为节奏的乡村，远处没有烟囱
scene: 麦收之前，村里按户出工，谷仓门口堆着刚修好的农具。In an agricultural society, most families grow the food they eat.
sceneCN: 这里 agricultural society 指「以农业生产为主导的社会」（第 1 个义项：以农耕为基础的社会）；句意为在农业社会里，多数家庭自己种植所吃的粮食。图中可辨识物件：田块、水渠、谷仓、修好的农具、按户出工的人群。

collocations.phrase: the transition from an agricultural society

collocations.zh: 工业化之前的农业社会

senses.title: A society centred on farming
senses.definition: a society in which most people work the land and most wealth comes from crops and livestock
senses.definitionCN: 多数人耕作土地、多数财富来自作物与牲畜的社会
senses.example: In an agricultural society, most families grow the food they eat.
senses.exampleCN: 在农业社会里，多数家庭自己种植所吃的粮食。
senses.why: the phrase names the sector that organizes the whole society, not merely an industry that exists inside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语命名的是组织整个社会的部门，而不只是社会中存在的一项产业。

senses.title: A stage in development typology
senses.titleCN: 发展阶段类型中的一个阶段
senses.definition: the first stage in the classification that runs from agricultural to industrial to post-industrial
senses.definitionCN: 从农业到工业再到后工业的分类中的第一个阶段
senses.example: The typology places agricultural society before industrial society.
senses.exampleCN: 类型学把农业社会排在工业社会之前。
senses.why: one type becomes a stage when societies are arranged along a single line of development.
senses.whyCN: 当社会被排在同一条发展线上时，一个类型就变成一个阶段。

senses.title: Its village and kinship order
senses.definition: the social order of villages, households and kin groups that farming settlements produce
senses.definitionCN: 农业定居点所产生的村落、家庭与亲族群体的社会秩序
senses.example: Agricultural society rested on extended families that farmed together.
senses.exampleCN: 农业社会依靠共同耕作的大家庭。
senses.why: land is worked by households rather than individuals, so kinship becomes the basic unit of organization.
senses.whyCN: 土地由家庭而非个人耕作，因此亲族关系成为基本组织单位。

senses.title: A seasonal rhythm of work
senses.titleCN: 按季节运转的劳动节奏
senses.definition: a yearly cycle of planting, tending and harvesting that sets the calendar of work
senses.definitionCN: 播种、照料与收割构成的年度周期，决定工作的历法
senses.example: In agricultural society the hiring year began at harvest, not in January.
senses.exampleCN: 在农业社会，雇工年从收割开始，而非一月。
senses.why: when output depends on weather and ripening, time is measured by the crop rather than by the clock.
senses.whyCN: 当产出取决于天气与成熟，时间便按作物而非钟表来计量。

senses.title: Land as the basis of wealth
senses.definition: an order in which owning land, not holding money, is the main source of status and security
senses.definitionCN: 拥有土地而非持有金钱，是地位与保障主要来源的秩序
senses.example: In agricultural society a family's rank was read from its acres.
senses.exampleCN: 在农业社会，一个家庭的地位从它的田亩数看出来。
senses.why: land is the one asset that cannot be multiplied at will, so its ownership fixes the social ladder.
senses.whyCN: 土地是无法随意增殖的资产，因此其所有权固定了社会阶梯。

senses.title: Its characteristic institutions
senses.definition: the manor, the market town, the church and the storage barn that farming life requires
senses.definitionCN: 农耕生活所需要的庄园、集镇、教堂与储粮仓
senses.example: The tithe barn is the most visible institution of agricultural society.
senses.exampleCN: 什一税谷仓是农业社会最显眼的制度设施。
senses.why: storing seed and collecting dues are collective problems, so farming builds institutions around them.
senses.whyCN: 储存种子与收取租税是集体问题，农业便围绕它们建起制度。

senses.title: A historical era
senses.definition: the long period before industrialization when farming dominated most economies
senses.definitionCN: 工业化之前农耕主导多数经济体的漫长时期
senses.example: Historians date agricultural society differently in each region.
senses.exampleCN: 历史学者对各地区农业社会的断代并不相同。
senses.why: a social type with a clear end becomes a period that can be dated and compared.
senses.whyCN: 一个终结清楚的类型会成为可以断代与比较的时期。

senses.title: A present-day smallholder order
senses.definition: a contemporary society still organized mainly around small farms, often in the Global South
senses.definitionCN: 今天仍主要围绕小农场组织的社会，常位于全球南方
senses.example: Agricultural society has not disappeared; it survives in smallholder regions.
senses.exampleCN: 农业社会并未消失，它在小农地区延续。
senses.why: the typology is a sequence, not a law, so some societies remain agricultural while others industrialize.
senses.whyCN: 类型学是序列而非定律，因此一些社会仍以农业为主，另一些则已工业化。

intro.en: Agricultural joins Latin ager 'field' with cultura 'cultivation'; society comes from Latin societas, from socius 'ally'. The phrase belongs to modern social classification. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: agricultural 由拉丁 ager「田地」与 cultura「耕作」构成；society 来自拉丁 societas，其词根为 socius「盟友」。这个短语属于近代的社会分类。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ager meant 'field, farmland, territory'. It also gives acre, and its Indo-European source is a reconstruction rather than an attested form.
items.cn: ager 意为「田地、耕地、领地」，也构成 acre；它的印欧来源属重构形式，而非有据可查的形式。

items.en: Cultura meant 'tending, cultivation', from colere 'to till, inhabit, worship'; the same word later gave culture its figurative sense.
items.cn: cultura 意为「照料、耕作」，出自 colere「耕种、居住、敬奉」；同一个词后来又给出 culture 的比喻义。

items.en: Ager plus cultura gave agricultura 'field cultivation', and the adjective agriculturalis described what belongs to it.
items.cn: ager 与 cultura 构成 agricultura「田间耕作」，其形容词 agriculturalis 描述与之相关的事物。

items.en: English took agriculture from French in the fifteenth century, and agricultural followed as its adjective.
items.cn: 英语在 15 世纪经法语吸收 agriculture，agricultural 随后作为其形容词出现。

items.en: Nineteenth-century social thinkers paired the adjective with society to name the farming order that industry was replacing.
items.cn: 19 世纪的社会思想家把这个形容词与社会一词配对，用来命名正被工业取代的农耕秩序。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin root of ager is a reconstruction, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：ager 在拉丁语之前的词根属重构形式；这一确切短语的最早使用没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds land and farming words that look alike but divide the work differently; group two holds other labels for non-industrial orders.
note.cn: 第一组是同出土地与农耕、外形相近但分工不同的词；第二组是对非工业秩序的其他称谓。

entries.definition: A society defined by land ownership and rural class relations rather than by farming technique as such.
entries.definitionCN: 由土地所有权与农村阶级关系定义的社会，而不是由农耕技术本身定义。

entries.definition: A society organized around manufacturing; it replaces the farming order rather than existing beside it.
entries.definitionCN: 围绕制造业组织的社会；它取代农耕秩序，而不只是与之并列。

entries.definition: An economy whose output is mostly farm produce; it says nothing about village life or kinship.
entries.definitionCN: 产出以农产品为主的经济；不涉及村落生活或亲族关系。

entries.definition: The practice of farming itself, not the society built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 农耕活动本身，而非建立其上的社会。

entries.definition: A close relative that foregrounds land tenure and rural classes; the two labels are often used interchangeably.
entries.definitionCN: 近义说法，突出土地占有与农村阶级；两个称谓常可互换。

entries.definition: A society defined by where people live rather than by what they produce.
entries.definitionCN: 按人们居住地而非产出定义的社会。

entries.definition: A society of small cultivators bound to landlords and markets; it stresses class and tenure.
entries.definitionCN: 由小农组成、与地主和市场绑定的社会；强调阶级与土地占有。

entries.definition: Any society before factory industry, defined by what it lacks rather than by farming.
entries.definitionCN: 工厂工业之前的任何社会，按缺少什么而非按农耕来定义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective comes from field plus cultivation, so the phrase is a society living off fields.
normal.cn: 这个形容词由田地与耕作构成，因此短语指靠田地生活社会。

normal.en: The typology runs agricultural, industrial, post-industrial.
normal.cn: 类型学按农业、工业、后工业的顺序排列。

normal.en: Land, kinship and the harvest calendar are its three pillars.
normal.cn: 土地、亲族与收获历法是它的三根柱子。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as subsistence agricultural society mark the smallholder sense.
normal.cn: 自给自足的农业社会这类固定搭配标出小农义。

normal.en: The contrast with industrial society is built into the phrase.
normal.cn: 与工业社会的对照被写进了这个短语本身。

abstract.en: Picture a village whose clock is the height of the sun.
abstract.cn: 想象一座以太阳高度为时钟的村庄。

abstract.en: Picture a store of grain that is also a store of power.
abstract.cn: 想象一座粮仓同时也是一座权力库。

abstract.en: Picture a map where every boundary is a furrow.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，每条边界都是一道犁沟。

examples.en: Agricultural society expanded slowly because output depended on land and weather.
examples.cn: 农业社会扩张缓慢，因为产出取决于土地与天气。

examples.en: The novel contrasts agricultural society with the new mill town.
examples.cn: 这部小说把农业社会与新兴的工厂镇作对照。

examples.en: In agricultural society, debts were settled after the harvest.
examples.cn: 在农业社会，债务在收割之后结清。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「农业的（agricultural）+ 社会（society）」——以田地为生的社会，就是农业社会

root: 拉丁 ager「田地」+ cultura「耕作」→ agriculture、agricultural；拉丁 socius「同伴」→ societas「结社」→ society。两词在 19 世纪社会分类中连用。ager 的更深词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one farming order: a society living off the land, its stage in a typology, its villages and kin, its harvest calendar, land as wealth, its barns and manors, the long era before industry, and the smallholder present that still exists.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种农耕秩序展开：靠土地生活的社会、它在类型学中的阶段、它的村落与亲族、它的收获历法、作为财富的土地、它的谷仓与庄园、工业之前的漫长时代，以及至今仍存在的小农现状。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fields, channels, a barn and a village, with no chimney on the horizon.
core.cn: 核心意象：田块、水渠、谷仓与村落，天边没有烟囱。

branches.en: CENTRE: the base sense, a society whose livelihood comes from crops and livestock.
branches.cn: 中心：基础义，生计来自作物与牲畜的社会。

branches.en: PLACE IN TIME: a first stage in the typology and a long historical era.
branches.cn: 时间中的位置：类型学中的第一阶段，以及漫长的历史时期。

branches.en: RHYTHM: villages and kin groups work to a calendar set by planting and harvest.
branches.cn: 节奏：村落与亲族群按播种和收获设定的历法劳作。

branches.en: PROPERTY AND BUILDINGS: land fixes rank, and barns and manors organize dues and seed.
branches.cn: 财产与建筑：土地固定等级，谷仓与庄园组织租税与种子。

branches.en: PRESENT TENSE: the type is not extinct; smallholder regions still live it.
branches.cn: 现在时：这个类型并未灭绝，小农地区仍生活于其中。

intro.en: The phrase joins a farming adjective built from field and cultivation to a noun of association, and both halves are productive.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一个由田地与耕作构成的农业形容词，连到一个结社名词，两半都很有构词力。

latinIntro.en: Latin ager and cultura build agriculture and agricultural; Latin socius builds society, social and associate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ager 与 cultura 构成 agriculture 与 agricultural；拉丁 socius 构成 society、social 与 associate。

items.example: The root names the ground being worked.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指被耕作的地。

items.example: The second element names the work done on the land.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分指在土地上所做的劳作。

items.example: Agriculture employs half the district.
items.exampleCN: 农业雇用了这个地区一半的人。

items.example: It turns the noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把名词变成形容词。

items.example: Agricultural wages rose after the harvest.
items.exampleCN: 收割之后农业工资上涨。

items.example: The root names people bound together.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指彼此联结的人。

items.example: It builds the noun of association.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示结社的名词。

items.example: Society outlived the manor.
items.exampleCN: 社会比庄园存续得更久。

items.example: It builds the adjective from the noun.
items.exampleCN: 它由名词构成形容词。

definition_zh: 土地的；农业的；农村的；（名词）主张土地改革者
definition_en: relating to land, its ownership and its cultivation, or to the rural order built on it
core_image: 一张地契压在木桌上，旁边是犁、界石与一小袋谷种
scene: 村公所的抽屉里放着几份旧地契，田界用石头标着。Land disputes in the valley are settled by agrarian law that dates back centuries.
sceneCN: 这里 agrarian 指「与土地及其占有关系有关的」（第 1 个义项：土地与土地占有的）；句意为这个河谷的土地纠纷依数百年前传下的土地法解决。图中可辨识物件：地契、木桌、犁、界石、谷种。

pos.zh: 主张土地改革者；平均地权论者

forms.label: 名词复数（主张土地改革者）

derivatives.zh: 土地改革主义；农本主义

senses.title: Of land and its ownership
senses.definition: relating to land as property, especially to who owns and who works it
senses.definitionCN: 与作为财产的土地有关，尤其涉及谁拥有、谁耕作
senses.example: Land disputes in the valley are settled by agrarian law that dates back centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这个河谷的土地纠纷依数百年前传下的土地法解决。
senses.why: the word comes from the Latin word for field, so its core is land as an object held and divided.
senses.whyCN: 这个词出自拉丁语中表示田地的词，因此其核心是作为被占有、被分割之物的土地。

senses.title: Of farming as a way of life
senses.titleCN: 作为一种生活方式的农耕
senses.definition: relating to the practice and rhythm of cultivating the soil
senses.definitionCN: 与耕作土地的实践和节奏有关
senses.example: The museum records the agrarian year from ploughing to threshing.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆记录了从犁地到脱粒的农事一年。
senses.why: owning land and working it are two sides of the same order, so the adjective covers both.
senses.whyCN: 拥有土地与耕作土地是同一秩序的两面，因此这个形容词两者都涵盖。

senses.title: Of land redistribution
senses.definition: used of reforms that change who holds land, often breaking up large estates
senses.definitionCN: 用于改变土地持有者的改革，常拆散大庄园
senses.example: Agrarian reform gave tenants title to the fields they farmed.
senses.exampleCN: 土地改革把佃农所耕田地的产权给了他们。
senses.why: if land is the basis of power, then changing its ownership is the central political demand of the word.
senses.whyCN: 如果土地是权力基础，那么改变其所有权就是这个词的核心政治诉求。

senses.title: Of a rural social order
senses.titleCN: 农村社会秩序意义上的
senses.definition: describing societies or economies organized around land, villages and rural classes
senses.definitionCN: 描述围绕土地、村落与农村阶级组织起来的社会或经济
senses.example: The region remained agrarian long after the coast industrialized.
senses.exampleCN: 沿海工业化很久之后，这个地区仍以农业为主。
senses.why: the adjective can describe a whole order, not only a single plot or law.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词可以描述整个秩序，而不只是单块土地或单条法律。

senses.title: A land-reform advocate
senses.definition: a person who campaigns for a fairer distribution of land
senses.definitionCN: 为更公平的土地分配而奔走的人
senses.example: The agrarian spoke at every village meeting that summer.
senses.exampleCN: 那年夏天，这位土地改革者在每次村会上发言。
senses.why: the adjective became a noun for the person who carries its political programme.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词转为名词，指承载其政治纲领的人。

senses.title: Roman land law
senses.definition: the body of ancient Roman laws about the division and use of public land
senses.definitionCN: 古罗马关于公地分配与使用的法律体系
senses.example: The agrarian laws limited how much public land one family could hold.
senses.exampleCN: 土地法限制一个家庭能占有的公地上限。
senses.why: the phrase is fixed in Roman history, where land division was a standing political conflict.
senses.whyCN: 这个说法在罗马史中固定下来，因为土地分配是长期的政治冲突。

senses.title: Of a farmed landscape
senses.definition: describing a landscape or ecology shaped by centuries of cultivation
senses.definitionCN: 描述被数百年耕作塑造的景观或生态
senses.example: The agrarian landscape of hedges and terraces supports many species.
senses.exampleCN: 由树篱与梯田构成的农耕景观养活了众多物种。
senses.why: land that has been worked for generations becomes a visible pattern, and the adjective names that pattern.
senses.whyCN: 被世代耕作的土地会成为可见的图案，这个形容词命名那种图案。

senses.title: Of rural unrest
senses.definition: describing conflict or crisis rooted in land hunger and tenure
senses.definitionCN: 描述源于土地饥渴与占有关系的冲突或危机
senses.example: The agrarian crisis drove thousands off the land and into the cities.
senses.exampleCN: 农业危机把成千上万人赶离土地、涌入城市。
senses.why: when tenure is unjust or unviable, the same word shifts from description to the name of a crisis.
senses.whyCN: 当土地占有不公或难以为继时，同一个词便从描述转为危机之名。

intro.en: Agrarian comes from Latin agrarius 'of land', built on ager 'field'. English adopted it in the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: agrarian 来自拉丁 agrarius「土地的」，由 ager「田地」构成。英语在 16 世纪吸收这个词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ager meant 'field, farmland, territory'. It also gives acre; its Indo-European source is reconstructed, not attested.
items.cn: ager 意为「田地、耕地、领地」，也构成 acre；其印欧来源属重构形式，而非有据可查的材料。

items.en: Agrarius meant 'of fields, relating to land', and was used of laws about public land and of the men who proposed them.
items.cn: agrarius 意为「田地的、与土地有关的」，用于关于公地的法律，也用于提出这些法律的人。

items.en: The leges agrariae of the Roman republic divided public land and limited holdings, which fixed the political sense of the word.
items.cn: 罗马共和国的土地法分配公地并限制占有上限，这固定了这个词的政治含义。

items.en: English took agrarian in the sixteenth century for matters of land and tenure, and later widened it to whole rural orders.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪吸收 agrarian，用于土地与占有事务，后来扩大到整个农村秩序。

items.en: Nineteenth-century land reform movements made the word a programme as well as a description, and its noun named the advocate.
items.cn: 19 世纪的土地改革运动使这个词既是描述也是纲领，其名词形式则指主张者。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin root of ager is a reconstruction, and the earliest English citation is not precisely fixed.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：ager 在拉丁语之前的词根属重构形式，最早的英语书证也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds the land-family words that are most often confused; group two holds near neighbours of rural life.
note.cn: 第一组是最易混淆的土地词族成员；第二组是农村生活的近邻说法。

entries.definition: Of farming technique and production; it describes how food is grown, while agrarian describes land tenure and the rural order.
entries.definitionCN: 指农耕技术与生产；描述粮食如何种植，而土地一词描述土地占有与农村秩序。

entries.definition: The science of crop production and soil management; a technical field, not a social order.
entries.definitionCN: 作物生产与土壤管理的科学；属技术领域，不是社会秩序。

entries.definition: A unit of land area; it descends from the same word for field but names a measure, not a social question.
entries.definitionCN: 土地面积单位；与田地一词同源，但指度量，不指社会问题。

entries.definition: To convert land or a community to small-scale farming; rare and technical, unlike the everyday adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 把土地或社群转为小农耕种；罕用且技术化，不同于日常形容词。

entries.definition: Of the countryside; it describes location and population density rather than land ownership.
entries.definitionCN: 乡村的；描述地点与人口密度，而非土地占有。

entries.definition: Of shepherds and grazing, and also of an idealized country life; it is not about crops or tenure.
entries.definitionCN: 牧人与放牧的，也指理想化的乡野生活；与作物或土地占有无关。

entries.definition: Describing people or families that own substantial land; it names the proprietor rather than the order.
entries.definitionCN: 描述拥有大量土地的人或家族；命名的是所有者而非秩序。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root means field, so agrarian is about land before it is about crops.
normal.cn: 词根意为田地，因此土地先于作物。

normal.en: Agrarian reform is the fixed phrase that shows the political sense.
normal.cn: 土地改革这一固定搭配展示了政治义。

normal.en: The pair agrarian and agricultural divides ownership from technique.
normal.cn: 土地的一词与农业的一词，把占有与技术分开。

normal.en: Roman agrarian laws are the historical anchor of the word.
normal.cn: 罗马土地法是这个词的历史锚点。

normal.en: As a noun it names the person who campaigns for land reform.
normal.cn: 作名词时，它指为土地改革奔走的人。

abstract.en: Picture a deed lying on a table beside a plough.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地契放在桌上，旁边是一把犁。

abstract.en: Picture a boundary stone that outlasts the families who argued over it.
abstract.cn: 想象一块界石比争它的人家存续得更久。

abstract.en: Picture a field divided by lines that only the law can see.
abstract.cn: 想象一块田被只有法律看得见的线分割。

examples.en: Agrarian reform was the central issue of the election.
examples.cn: 土地改革是这次选举的核心议题。

examples.en: The agrarian economy depended on one harvest a year.
examples.cn: 农业经济一年只依赖一次收成。

examples.en: Agrarian unrest followed the rise in rents.
examples.cn: 地租上涨之后出现了农村动荡。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「土地（agrarian）」——与田地、地契和界石打交道的，就是土地的、农业的

root: 拉丁 ager「田地」→ agrarius「土地的」→ 英语 agrarian。ager 的更深词根属重构形式；同源词包括 acre。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one plot of ground: land as property, farming as a way of life, redistribution, the rural order, the advocate, Roman land law, the farmed landscape and the unrest that tenure can cause.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一块地面展开：作为财产的土地、作为生活方式的农耕、土地再分配、农村秩序、主张改革的人、罗马土地法、被耕作塑造的景观，以及占有关系可能引发的动荡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deed, a plough, a boundary stone and a bag of seed on one table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌上放着地契、犁、界石与一袋谷种。

branches.en: PROPERTY: the base sense, land as something owned and divided.
branches.cn: 财产：基础义，作为被占有、被分割之物的土地。

branches.en: WORK AND LANDSCAPE: cultivation as a way of life, and the visible pattern it leaves.
branches.cn: 劳作与景观：作为生活方式的耕作，以及它留下的可见图案。

branches.en: REDISTRIBUTION: reform as a programme, and the advocate who carries it.
branches.cn: 再分配：作为纲领的改革，以及承载它的主张者。

branches.en: ORDER AND LAW: the rural order in general, and the Roman laws that fixed the term.
branches.cn: 秩序与法律：一般的农村秩序，以及固定这个术语的罗马法律。

branches.en: CONFLICT: when tenure fails, the same adjective names a crisis.
branches.cn: 冲突：当占有关系难以为继，同一个形容词成为危机之名。

intro.en: Agrarian is a Latin root plus an adjective suffix, and the root also yields agriculture and acre.
intro.cn: agrarian 由一个拉丁词根加一个形容词后缀构成，这个词根还给出 agriculture 与 acre。

latinIntro.en: Latin ager 'field' gives agrarius and agrarian, and through cultura it also gives agriculture.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ager「田地」给出 agrarius 与 agrarian，并经 cultura 给出 agriculture。

items.example: The root names the ground itself.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指土地本身。

items.example: It turns the land root into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把土地词根变成形容词。

items.example: Agrarian questions dominated the assembly.
items.exampleCN: 土地问题主导了议会。

items.example: It names the political programme of land reform.
items.exampleCN: 它命名土地改革的政治纲领。

items.meaningCN: 土地改革主义；农本主义
items.example: Agrarianism spread among the tenant farmers.
items.exampleCN: 农本主义在佃农中传播。

items.example: It forms the rare verb of conversion.
items.exampleCN: 它构成罕用的转换动词。

items.example: The board agrarianized the estate after the war.
items.exampleCN: 战后委员会把这片庄园改为小农耕种。

items.example: Agriculture fed the towns.
items.exampleCN: 农业养活了城镇。

items.structure: ager (Old English aecer, from the same root)
items.example: The field measured twelve acres.
items.exampleCN: 这块田有十二英亩。

derivatives.zh: 土地改革主义；农本主义

definition_zh: 农业社会；以土地占有与农耕关系为基础组织的社会
definition_en: a society organized around land ownership and the farming order built on it
core_image: 地契、界石、犁与谷仓构成一幅以土地为骨架的村庄图
scene: 村里的老人指着界石，讲起曾为一条田埂打过官司的往事。In an agrarian society, land ownership decides a family's standing.
sceneCN: 这里 agrarian society 指「围绕土地占有与农耕关系组织起来的社会」（第 1 个义项：以土地与农耕为基础的社会）；句意为在农业社会里，土地所有权决定一个家庭的地位。图中可辨识物件：地契、界石、犁、谷仓、田埂。

collocations.phrase: the transition from an agrarian society

derivatives.zh: 土地的 / 土地改革者

senses.title: A society built on land and farming
senses.titleCN: 以土地与农耕为基础的社会
senses.definition: a society in which land is the main source of livelihood, wealth and status
senses.definitionCN: 土地是生计、财富与地位主要来源的社会
senses.example: In an agrarian society, land ownership decides a family's standing.
senses.exampleCN: 在农业社会里，土地所有权决定一个家庭的地位。
senses.why: agrarian names land as property, so the phrase is a society whose order rests on who holds the fields.
senses.whyCN: 土地一词指作为财产的土地，因此这个短语指一个秩序取决于谁持有田地的社会。

senses.title: Its system of land tenure
senses.definition: the rules by which land is held, rented, inherited and worked
senses.definitionCN: 土地被持有、租佃、继承与耕作的规则
senses.example: Tenancy shaped agrarian society more than soil quality did.
senses.exampleCN: 租佃制度对农业社会的塑造甚于土壤质量。
senses.why: the same field can support very different societies depending on who holds it and on what terms.
senses.whyCN: 同一块田依据谁持有、以什么条件持有，可以支撑非常不同的社会。

senses.title: Village and kinship organization
senses.definition: the ordering of life through villages, households and extended kin
senses.definitionCN: 通过村落、家庭与扩展亲族来安排生活
senses.example: Agrarian society settled disputes inside the kin group before going to court.
senses.exampleCN: 农业社会先在亲族内部解决纠纷，再上法庭。
senses.why: farming is carried on by households, so the household and its kin become the working unit of society.
senses.whyCN: 农耕由家庭承担，因此家庭及其亲族成为社会的工作单位。

senses.title: A pre-industrial stage
senses.definition: the stage in development typology that precedes industrial society
senses.definitionCN: 发展类型学中先于工业社会的阶段
senses.example: The typology treats agrarian society as the stage before industry.
senses.exampleCN: 类型学把农业社会视为工业之前的阶段。
senses.why: a social type becomes a stage when it is placed on a single line of development.
senses.whyCN: 当一个社会类型被放到一条发展线上，它就成了阶段。

senses.title: A seasonal labour calendar
senses.titleCN: 按季节安排的劳动历法
senses.definition: a working year paced by ploughing, sowing, weeding and harvest
senses.definitionCN: 按犁地、播种、除草与收割安排的工作年
senses.example: In agrarian society, weddings waited until after the harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 在农业社会，婚礼要等到收割之后。
senses.why: when income arrives once a year, every social event is scheduled around the crop.
senses.whyCN: 当收入一年只来一次，一切社交活动都要围绕作物安排。

senses.title: Its class structure
senses.definition: the division between landowners, tenants and landless labourers
senses.definitionCN: 地主、佃农与无地劳工之间的划分
senses.example: Agrarian society was divided between those who held land and those who worked it.
senses.exampleCN: 农业社会分为持有土地者与耕作土地者。
senses.why: land is scarce and inheritable, so tenure hardens into classes that pass from generation to generation.
senses.whyCN: 土地稀缺且可继承，因此占有关系固化为代代相传的阶级。

senses.title: A historical era
senses.definition: the long period before industrialization in a given region
senses.definitionCN: 某一地区工业化之前的漫长时期
senses.example: The archive covers three centuries of agrarian society.
senses.exampleCN: 这批档案涵盖农业社会三个世纪的历史。
senses.why: historians date the era by the moment industry begins to dominate, not by a single event.
senses.whyCN: 历史学者以工业开始占主导的时刻断代，而非以单一事件。

senses.title: A contemporary rural order
senses.definition: a present-day society still organized around small farms and land tenure
senses.definitionCN: 今天仍围绕小农场与土地占有组织的社会
senses.example: Agrarian society persists where land reform stalled.
senses.exampleCN: 在土地改革停滞的地方，农业社会仍然延续。
senses.why: the typology describes a sequence, not an extinction, so the phrase still names living societies.
senses.whyCN: 类型学描述的是序列而非灭绝，因此这个短语仍命名活着的社会。

intro.en: Agrarian comes from Latin agrarius 'of land', from ager 'field'; society comes from Latin societas 'association'. The pairing belongs to modern social thought. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: agrarian 来自拉丁 agrarius「土地的」，其词根为 ager「田地」；society 来自拉丁 societas「结社」。这一配对属于近代社会思想。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ager meant 'field, farmland'. It also gives acre, and its Indo-European source is a reconstruction rather than an attested form.
items.cn: ager 意为「田地、耕地」，也构成 acre；其印欧来源属重构形式，而非有据可查的材料。

items.en: Agrarius 'of land' described laws about public land and the politicians who proposed them, so the legal sense is older than the social one.
items.cn: agrarius「土地的」用于关于公地的法律及提出这些法律的政治人物，因此法律义早于社会义。

items.en: Societas named an association or partnership among socii 'allies'; its deeper origin is not established.
items.cn: societas 指 socii「盟友」之间的结社或伙伴关系；其更深来源未得到证明。

items.en: Nineteenth-century social thinkers joined the two words to name the land-based order that industry was replacing.
items.cn: 19 世纪的社会思想家把这两个词连用，命名正被工业取代的、以土地为基础的秩序。

items.en: Development studies later applied the phrase to present-day smallholder regions, where land tenure still orders society.
items.cn: 发展研究后来把这个短语用于当代小农地区，那里的土地占有仍在安排社会。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origins and first date): the pre-Latin root of ager and the origin of socius are reconstructions, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：ager 在拉丁语之前的词根与 socius 的来源均属重构形式；这一确切短语的最早使用没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds land-based social labels that are nearly interchangeable; group two holds orders defined by other features.
note.cn: 第一组是几乎可以互换的、以土地为基础的社会称谓；第二组是按其他特征定义的社会秩序。

entries.definition: A society defined by what it produces; the two phrases overlap heavily, but this one stresses crops rather than tenure.
entries.definitionCN: 按产出定义的社会；两个短语大量重叠，但这个更强调作物而非土地占有。

entries.definition: A society organized around manufacturing, which replaces the land order.
entries.definitionCN: 围绕制造业组织的社会，它取代土地秩序。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning of land; it can modify reform, law or crisis without naming a whole society.
entries.definitionCN: 意为土地的那个形容词；可修饰改革、法律或危机，不必指整个社会。

entries.definition: The rules of holding land, which are central to agrarian society but are only one of its features.
entries.definitionCN: 持有土地的规则，是农业社会的核心，但只是其特征之一。

entries.definition: A society of small cultivators tied to landlords and markets; it stresses class position rather than the type of economy.
entries.definitionCN: 由小农组成、与地主和市场绑定的社会；强调阶级位置而非经济类型。

entries.definition: A society defined by low density and country living; it may still depend on industry for income.
entries.definitionCN: 以低密度与乡居生活定义的社会；收入仍可能依赖工业。

entries.definition: A society of lords, vassals and serfs bound by obligations; narrower and more political than agrarian society.
entries.definitionCN: 由领主、封臣与农奴按义务联结的社会；比农业社会更窄、更政治化。

entries.definition: Any society before factory industry, including trading and pastoral ones that are not agrarian.
entries.definitionCN: 工厂工业之前的任何社会，包括并非农业的贸易社会与游牧社会。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The adjective means of land, so the phrase is a society ordered by who holds the fields.
normal.cn: 这个形容词意为土地的，因此短语指一个按谁持有田地来排序的社会。

normal.en: Tenure is the hinge: landowners, tenants and labourers.
normal.cn: 土地占有是铰链：地主、佃农与劳工。

normal.en: The village and the kin group are its working units.
normal.cn: 村落与亲族群是它的工作单位。

normal.en: The harvest sets its calendar and its debts.
normal.cn: 收割决定它的历法与债务。

normal.en: The pair agrarian society and industrial society is a standard contrast.
normal.cn: 农业社会与工业社会是一组标准对照。

abstract.en: Picture a boundary stone that decides more than any fence.
abstract.cn: 想象一块界石比任何篱笆都更能决定事情。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger of land that doubles as a list of who may speak.
abstract.cn: 想象一本土地账簿同时是一份谁可以说话的名单。

abstract.en: Picture a village where the harvest is the only clock that matters.
abstract.cn: 想象一座村庄，收割是唯一重要的时钟。

examples.en: Agrarian society gave way slowly to wage labour in the towns.
examples.cn: 农业社会缓慢地让位给城镇里的雇佣劳动。

examples.en: Reformers argued that agrarian society kept half the population illiterate.
examples.cn: 改革者认为农业社会使一半人口不识字。

examples.en: The survey compares agrarian society in three mountain districts.
examples.cn: 这项调查比较了三个山区的农业社会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「土地的（agrarian）+ 社会（society）」——按谁持有田地来排序的社会，就是农业社会

root: 拉丁 ager「田地」→ agrarius「土地的」→ agrarian；拉丁 socius「同伴」→ societas「结社」→ society。两词在 19 世纪社会思想中连用。两词更深来源均属重构或不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one land order: a society living off fields, its tenure rules, its villages and kin, its pre-industrial stage, its harvest calendar, its classes, its historical era and the rural present that continues where reform stalled.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一种土地秩序展开：靠田地为生的社会、它的占有规则、它的村落与亲族、它的前工业阶段、它的收获历法、它的阶级、它的历史时期，以及改革停滞后仍在延续的农村现状。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deed, a boundary stone, a plough and a barn making the frame of one village.
core.cn: 核心意象：地契、界石、犁与谷仓构成一座村庄的骨架。

branches.en: LAND BASE: the base sense, a society whose livelihood, wealth and rank come from land.
branches.cn: 土地基础：基础义，生计、财富与等级都来自土地的社会。

branches.en: TENURE AND CLASSES: the rules of holding land harden into landlords, tenants and labourers.
branches.cn: 占有与阶级：持有土地的规则固化为地主、佃农与劳工。

branches.en: HOUSEHOLD TIME: kin groups work, settle disputes and marry around the harvest.
branches.cn: 家庭时间：亲族群围绕收割劳作、解决纠纷与婚嫁。

branches.en: PLACE IN HISTORY: a pre-industrial stage that becomes a dated era in each region.
branches.cn: 历史中的位置：前工业阶段在各地区成为可断代的时期。

branches.en: PRESENT: where reform stalled, the same order is still lived.
branches.cn: 现在：在改革停滞之处，同一秩序仍被人生活着。

intro.en: The phrase is a land adjective plus a noun of association, and both halves carry productive pieces.
intro.cn: 这个短语由一个土地形容词加一个结社名词构成，两半都带着能产的构词成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin ager and agrarius build agrarian; Latin socius and societas build society and social.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ager 与 agrarius 构成 agrarian；拉丁 socius 与 societas 构成 society 与 social。

items.example: The root names the ground being held.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指被持有的土地。

items.example: It turns the land root into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把土地词根变成形容词。

items.example: Agrarian rules governed the commons.
items.exampleCN: 土地规则管理着公地。

items.example: The root names people bound together.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根指彼此联结的人。

items.example: It builds the noun of association.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示结社的名词。

items.example: Society changed when tenure changed.
items.exampleCN: 占有关系一变，社会也随之改变。

items.example: It builds the adjective from the noun.
items.exampleCN: 它由名词构成形容词。

items.example: Social rank followed the land.
items.exampleCN: 社会等级随土地而定。

items.example: Agrarianism demanded a new survey of holdings.
items.exampleCN: 土地改革主义要求重新丈量土地。

derivatives.zh: 土地的 / 土地改革者

definition_zh: 经济的；经济学的；经济上可行的；有利可图的
definition_en: relating to the production, distribution and use of wealth, or to the money a course of action requires
core_image: 一张桌上摊着账本、硬币、工厂平面图与一份预算表，四样东西指向同一条收支链
scene: 镇上的议事厅里，委员们把修桥的报价单与预算表并排摊开。The bridge was not economic at that price, so the plan was dropped.
sceneCN: 这里 economic 指「在花费上划算、经济上可行」（第 3 个义项：经济上划算的）；句意为按那个报价修桥不划算，因此计划被放弃。图中可辨识物件：账本、硬币、工厂平面图、预算表、报价单。

pos.zh: 经济的；经济学的；经济上可行的；有利可图的

senses.title: Relating to the economy
senses.definition: concerning the production, trade and consumption of goods and services in a society
senses.definitionCN: 关于一个社会中商品与服务的生产、贸易与消费
senses.example: The bridge was not economic at that price, so the plan was dropped.
senses.exampleCN: 按那个报价修桥不划算，因此计划被放弃。
senses.why: the adjective names the whole field of producing and using wealth, so it can describe anything measured in that field.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词指生产与使用财富的整个领域，因此可以描述该领域中被计量的任何事物。

senses.title: Relating to public finances
senses.definition: concerning a country's income, spending, prices and jobs as a matter of policy
senses.definitionCN: 作为政策事项，关于一个国家的收入、支出、物价与就业
senses.example: Economic policy changed direction after the election.
senses.exampleCN: 选举之后，经济政策改变了方向。
senses.why: once governments manage the economy, the adjective attaches to the instruments they use.
senses.whyCN: 一旦政府管理经济，这个形容词便附着于它所使用的工具。

senses.title: Financially worthwhile
senses.definition: worth doing because the return exceeds the cost
senses.definitionCN: 因收益超过成本而值得做的
senses.example: It is not economic to mine that seam at today's prices.
senses.exampleCN: 按今天的价格开采那个煤层不划算。
senses.why: the adjective shifts from describing the field to judging one decision inside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词从描述领域，转为判断领域中的某一项决定。

senses.title: Sparing in the use of resources
senses.definition: careful not to waste money or materials, an older use now usually carried by economical
senses.definitionCN: 小心不浪费金钱或材料；这是较旧的用法，现在通常改说另一个表示「节约的」形容词
senses.example: The older manuals praise an economic use of coal.
senses.exampleCN: 较早的手册称赞节约用煤。
senses.why: the two adjectives split over time, and the shorter one kept this thrifty sense in older texts.
senses.whyCN: 两个形容词随时间分了工，较短的那个在较早文本中保留了这层节约义。

senses.title: Of household management
senses.definition: relating to the ordering of a household, the original sense of the Greek source
senses.definitionCN: 与家庭事务的安排有关，这是希腊语来源的原始义
senses.example: Ancient writers treated economic questions as household questions.
senses.exampleCN: 古代作家把经济问题当作家庭问题来处理。
senses.why: the Greek word meant household management, and that older frame still survives in histories of the term.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语原词意为家庭管理，这一较早的框架仍存留在该词的历史叙述中。

senses.title: Of economics as a discipline
senses.definition: belonging to the academic study of production, markets and choice
senses.definitionCN: 属于对生产、市场与选择所作的学术研究
senses.example: Economic theory predicts that prices clear the market.
senses.exampleCN: 经济理论预言价格会使市场出清。
senses.why: a field of study needs an adjective, and this one marks arguments made inside it.
senses.whyCN: 一门研究需要形容词，这个词标记在该学科内部作出的论证。

senses.title: Of value set by the market
senses.titleCN: 由市场决定的价值意义上的
senses.definition: describing worth measured in money rather than in beauty, justice or sentiment
senses.definitionCN: 描述以金钱而非美、正义或情感衡量的价值
senses.example: The forest has an economic value and a cultural one.
senses.exampleCN: 这片森林既有经济价值，也有文化价值。
senses.why: the adjective marks one kind of value among several, which is why it so often appears beside cultural or social.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词在多种价值中标出其中一种，因此常与文化或社会并列。

senses.title: Material or self-interested
senses.titleCN: 物质利益与自利动机意义上的
senses.definition: describing motives or reasoning based on money and advantage rather than principle
senses.definitionCN: 描述基于金钱与利益而非原则的动机或推理
senses.example: They left for economic reasons, not political ones.
senses.exampleCN: 他们离开是出于经济原因，而非政治原因。
senses.why: when the adjective modifies a motive, it contrasts money with values of other kinds.
senses.whyCN: 当这个形容词修饰动机时，它把金钱与其他类型的价值对照起来。

intro.en: Economic comes from Greek oikonomia 'household management', from oikos 'house' plus nomos 'law, custom', by way of Latin oeconomia and French economique. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: economic 来自希腊 oikonomia「家庭管理」，由 oikos「家」与 nomos「法、习俗」构成，经拉丁 oeconomia 与法语 economique 进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Oikos meant 'house, household, family property'. It is the root of economy, ecology and ecumenical, three very different English families.
items.cn: oikos 意为「家、家庭、家产」。它是 economy、ecology 与 ecumenical 三个差异很大的英语词族的共同词根。

items.en: Nomos meant 'law, custom, arrangement'. Scholars connect it with a verb meaning to distribute or manage, but that link is a hypothesis rather than a proven derivation.
items.cn: nomos 意为「法、习俗、安排」。学者把它与一个表示分配或管理的动词联系起来，但这一联系只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Oikonomia named the management of a household and its property, a practical art rather than a theory of markets.
items.cn: oikonomia 指对家庭及其财产的管理，是一门实践技艺，而不是市场理论。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek word as oeconomia, keeping the household sense, and passed it to French and English.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入希腊词作 oeconomia，保留家庭义，并把它传给法语与英语。

items.en: English economic appeared in the sixteenth century, and by the eighteenth it referred to the wealth of nations rather than of households.
items.cn: 英语 economic 出现于 16 世纪，到 18 世纪已指国家的财富而非家庭的财富。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Greek origin of nomos and its link to the verb of distributing are reconstructions, and the earliest English use is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：nomos 在希腊语之前的来源及其与「分配」动词的联系均属重构，最早的英语使用也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds the same-root words that are constantly confused; group two holds adjectives of money and finance.
note.cn: 第一组是同根而极易混淆的词；第二组是关于金钱与金融的形容词。

entries.definition: Saving money or materials in use; a small car is economical, while an economic policy is about the economy.
entries.definitionCN: 使用时省钱省料；小车是节约的，而经济政策是关于经济的。

entries.definition: The academic study of production, markets and choice; it takes a singular verb as a subject name.
entries.definitionCN: 研究生产、市场与选择的学科；作学科名时用单数动词。

entries.definition: The system of production and consumption itself, or thrift in spending; the adjective describes what belongs to it.
entries.definitionCN: 生产与消费的体系本身，或开支上的节约；形容词描述属于它的事物。

entries.definition: A person who studies or advises on the economy; not to be confused with the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 研究或为经济提供建议的人；不要与形容词混淆。

entries.definition: Of money, banking and accounts; it concerns funds and balance sheets rather than production as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 关于金钱、银行与账目；关注资金与资产负债表，而非整个生产。

entries.definition: Of government revenue and spending; it is one instrument of economic policy, not the whole of it.
entries.definitionCN: 关于政府收入与支出；是经济政策的一项工具，而非全部。

entries.definition: Of money as a medium and of interest rates; another instrument beside fiscal policy.
entries.definitionCN: 关于作为媒介的货币与利率；与财政政策并列的另一项工具。

entries.definition: Of buying and selling for profit; it describes transactions rather than the whole economy.
entries.definitionCN: 关于为获利而买卖；描述交易，而非整个经济。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The Greek source means household management, so the adjective begins at the kitchen table and ends at the national budget.
normal.cn: 希腊来源意为家庭管理，因此这个形容词从厨房餐桌一路走到国家预算。

normal.en: The pair economic and economical divides the field from thrift.
normal.cn: 经济的一词与节约的一词，把领域与节俭分开。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as economic growth and economic policy belong to the national sense.
normal.cn: 经济增长、经济政策这类固定搭配属于国家层面义。

normal.en: Economic value is always one value among others.
normal.cn: 经济价值永远是多种价值中的一种。

normal.en: The same root gives ecology, because both words begin with the household.
normal.cn: 同一个词根还给出生态学，因为两个词都从「家」开始。

abstract.en: Picture a household ledger that grows until it covers a whole country.
abstract.cn: 想象一本家庭账簿不断变大，直到覆盖整个国家。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag attached to a forest, a river and a friendship.
abstract.cn: 想象价签被贴到森林、河流与一段友谊上。

abstract.en: Picture a scale with money on one pan and principle on the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，一边放金钱，一边放原则。

examples.en: The region suffered an economic shock when the mine closed.
examples.cn: 矿场关闭时，这个地区遭受了一次经济冲击。

examples.en: The committee judged the project economic within five years.
examples.cn: 委员会判断该项目在五年内可以收回成本。

examples.en: Economic reasons were cited more often than political ones.
examples.cn: 经济原因被提及的次数多于政治原因。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一家·管账」——从家庭管账扩展到国家收支，就是经济的

root: 希腊 oikos「家」+ nomos「法、习俗」→ oikonomia「家庭管理」→ 拉丁 oeconomia → 法语 economique → 英语 economic。nomos 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one ledger: the economy as a field, public finance, a worthwhile return, thrift, household management, the discipline, market value and material motive.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一本账簿展开：作为领域的经济、公共财政、值得的回报、节约、家庭管理、学科、市场价值与物质动机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger, coins, a factory plan and a budget sheet on one table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张桌上放着账本、硬币、工厂平面图与预算表。

branches.en: ORIGIN AND FIELD: the household ledger widens into the economy as a whole.
branches.cn: 起源与领域：家庭账簿扩展为整个经济。

branches.en: POLICY: the state manages income, prices and jobs.
branches.cn: 政策：国家管理收入、物价与就业。

branches.en: ARITHMETIC: a return that exceeds cost, and a use that wastes nothing.
branches.cn: 算术：收益超过成本，以及不浪费任何东西的使用。

branches.en: THEORY AND PRICE: the discipline that models choice, and the value it measures.
branches.cn: 理论与价格：对选择建模的学科，以及它所计量的价值。

branches.en: MOTIVE: money set against principle as a reason for acting.
branches.cn: 动机：作为行动理由的金钱，与原则相对。

intro.en: Economic is a Greek compound plus an adjective suffix, and the same pieces build economy, ecology and economics.
intro.cn: economic 由一个希腊复合词加一个形容词后缀构成，同样的成分也构成 economy、ecology 与 economics。

latinIntro.en: Greek oikos 'house' and nomos 'law, arrangement' form oikonomia; Latin oeconomia carries it into European languages, and -ic shapes the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 oikos「家」与 nomos「法、安排」构成 oikonomia；拉丁 oeconomia 把它带入欧洲各语言，-ic 构成形容词。

items.example: The first element names the household being managed.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分指被管理的家。

items.example: The second element names the ordering of the house.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分指对家庭的安排。

items.meaning: household management, then the wealth system
items.meaningCN: 家庭管理，后指经济体系
items.example: The economy grew by three per cent.
items.exampleCN: 经济增长了三个百分点。

items.example: It turns the noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把名词变成形容词。

items.example: Economic output fell for two quarters.
items.exampleCN: 经济产出连续两个季度下降。

items.structure: -ika (Greek suffix for a field of study)
items.example: It turns the adjective into a discipline name.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成学科名。

items.example: Economics studies choice under scarcity.
items.exampleCN: 经济学研究稀缺条件下的选择。

items.example: It names a practitioner of the field.
items.exampleCN: 它为这一领域的从业者命名。

items.example: The economist advised the ministry.
items.exampleCN: 这位经济学家为部里提供建议。

latinEntries.structure: oeconomia, oeconomiae (f., first declension, from Greek)

definition_en: the growth and structural improvement of an economy and of the living standards it supports
core_image: 一张分四格的图：产量上升、工厂增多、道路延伸、家庭收入提高，四格由同一支箭头串起
scene: 县里的规划室里，一张旧地图被钉在墙上，铁路线从空白处一路画到海边。Economic development brought the first paved road to the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 economic development 指「基础设施与生活条件的改善」（第 3 个义项：生活水平与制度的改善）；句意为经济发展把第一条铺好的公路带到了这个河谷。图中可辨识物件：规划图、旧地图、铁路线、铺好的公路、上升的产量曲线。

pos.zh: 经济发展；经济开发（不可数；指具体项目时可作可数）

senses.title: Growth in output and income
senses.definition: a sustained rise in what an economy produces and what its people earn
senses.definitionCN: 一个经济体所生产的数量与其人民所获收入的持续上升
senses.example: Economic development brought the first paved road to the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 经济发展把第一条铺好的公路带到了这个河谷。
senses.why: development implies a movement from a lower to a higher state, so the phrase begins with measurable growth.
senses.whyCN: development 含从较低状态走向较高状态的移动，因此这个短语从可测量的增长开始。

senses.title: Structural transformation
senses.definition: the shift of jobs and output from farming to industry and then to services
senses.definitionCN: 就业与产出从农业转向工业、再转向服务业的转移
senses.example: Economic development moved labour from the fields to the mills.
senses.exampleCN: 经济发展把劳动力从田地移向工厂。
senses.why: growth by itself can occur without change, so the phrase also names the reshaping of what an economy does.
senses.whyCN: 增长本身可以在不改变结构的情况下发生，因此这个短语也指经济所从事之事的重塑。

senses.title: Better living standards and institutions
senses.titleCN: 生活水平与制度的改善
senses.definition: improvement in health, schooling, infrastructure and public capacity, not only in income
senses.definitionCN: 健康、教育、基础设施与公共能力的改善，不只是收入
senses.example: Economic development is measured by clinics and schools as well as by wages.
senses.exampleCN: 经济发展既用工资来衡量，也用诊所与学校来衡量。
senses.why: the phrase was widened because income can rise while living conditions stagnate.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语被拓宽，是因为收入可以上升而生活条件停滞。

senses.title: A field of policy and programmes
senses.definition: government or agency activity aimed at raising a region's economy
senses.definitionCN: 旨在提升一个地区经济的政府或机构活动
senses.example: The county created an economic development office in the 1960s.
senses.exampleCN: 这个县在 20 世纪 60 年代设立了经济发展办公室。
senses.why: a process becomes an administrative field once public money and offices are assigned to it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦公共资金与机构被分配给它，一个过程就成了行政领域。

senses.title: Local and regional development
senses.definition: the improvement of one town's or region's jobs, land and services
senses.definitionCN: 一个城镇或地区的就业、土地与服务的改善
senses.example: Regional economic development depends on rail links.
senses.exampleCN: 区域经济发展依赖铁路连接。
senses.why: the phrase scales down from nations to counties, where the same logic applies to a smaller map.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语从国家缩小到郡县，同一逻辑适用于更小的地图。

senses.title: A branch of economics
senses.definition: the academic field that studies how poor economies grow and change
senses.definitionCN: 研究贫穷经济体如何增长与变化的研究领域
senses.example: Development economics asks why some countries caught up and others did not.
senses.exampleCN: 发展经济学追问为什么一些国家赶上了，另一些没有。
senses.why: a policy problem becomes a discipline when it acquires its own models and data.
senses.whyCN: 当一个问题获得自己的模型与数据，它就成了一门学科。

senses.title: The historical process of industrialization
senses.definition: the long transformation by which agrarian economies became industrial ones
senses.definitionCN: 农业经济转变为工业经济的漫长转变
senses.example: Economic development in Europe took two centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 欧洲的经济发展用了两个世纪。
senses.why: historians use the phrase for the whole transition, not for a single year's growth figure.
senses.whyCN: 历史学者用这个短语指整个转型，而不是某一年的增长数字。

senses.title: Development as distinct from growth
senses.definition: qualitative improvement that is not captured by a rise in output alone
senses.definitionCN: 仅靠产出上升无法衡量的质的改善
senses.example: The report distinguishes economic development from mere growth.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把经济发展与单纯增长区分开来。
senses.why: if growth is more, development is better, and the distinction is the phrase's most debated edge.
senses.whyCN: 如果增长是「更多」，发展就是「更好」，这一区分正是该短语最有争议的边缘。

intro.en: Economic comes from Greek oikonomia 'household management'; development comes from Old French desveloper 'to unwrap, unfold'. The phrase belongs to twentieth-century development policy. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: economic 来自希腊 oikonomia「家庭管理」；development 来自古法语 desveloper「解开、展开」。这个短语属于 20 世纪的发展政策。年代均为约数。

items.en: Oikonomia joined oikos 'house' to nomos 'law, arrangement' to name the management of a household and its property.
items.cn: oikonomia 把 oikos「家」与 nomos「法、安排」结合起来，指对家庭及其财产的管理。

items.en: Latin borrowed the word as oeconomia, and European languages later narrowed its adjective to the wealth of states rather than households.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入该词作 oeconomia，欧洲各语言后来把它的形容词收窄为国家的财富，而非家庭的财富。

items.en: Desveloper meant 'to unwrap, unfold', from des- 'un-' plus a stem of uncertain origin; its source is uncertain and no reconstruction is offered, while the modern sense of gradual growth comes from this image of unfolding.
items.cn: desveloper 意为「解开、展开」，由表示「相反」的 des- 加一个来源不确定的词干构成；现代「逐渐生长」义正来自这一展开的意象。

items.en: English development first meant the act of unfolding or bringing out what was latent, then the growth of a country or an economy.
items.cn: 英语 development 最初指展开或使潜在之物显现，后来指国家或经济的成长。

items.en: After 1945 the pair became a policy label for aid, investment and planning in poorer countries, and later for regional programmes at home.
items.cn: 1945 年之后，这一配对成为对较贫穷国家提供援助、投资与规划的政策标签，后来又用于本国的区域计划。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origins and first date): the stem behind desveloper is unsettled, the pre-Greek origin of nomos is a reconstruction, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：desveloper 的词干尚无定论，nomos 在希腊语之前的来源属重构，这一确切短语的最早使用也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds phrases that are constantly substituted for this one; group two holds the wider processes it belongs to.
note.cn: 第一组是常被拿来替换本短语的说法；第二组是它所属的更广泛过程。

entries.definition: A rise in output, usually measured as a percentage per year; it is the measurable half of development.
entries.definitionCN: 产出的上升，通常以年度百分比计量；是发展中可测量的那一半。

entries.definition: Plain-language improvement with a positive glow; it carries no precise measure.
entries.definitionCN: 带正面色彩的日常说法；没有精确的度量。

entries.definition: Government direction of investment and output; a tool used to pursue development, not development itself.
entries.definitionCN: 政府对投资与产出的指导；是追求发展的工具，而非发展本身。

entries.definition: An organization that promotes local investment; the body, not the process it serves.
entries.definitionCN: 推动本地投资的机构；是机构，而非它所服务的过程。

entries.definition: The building of factory industry; the classic path of development but not the only one.
entries.definitionCN: 工厂工业的建立；是发展的经典路径，但不是唯一路径。

entries.definition: The broader turn to science, schooling and urban life, of which economic change is one part.
entries.definitionCN: 朝向科学、教育与城市生活的更广泛转变，经济变化只是其中一部分。

entries.definition: Any process of growth or unfolding; without economic in front, it can mean housing, skills or land.
entries.definitionCN: 任何成长或展开的过程；前面没有经济一词时，可指住房、技能或土地开发。

entries.definition: Improvement in health, education and choice, used to correct income-only measures of development.
entries.definitionCN: 健康、教育与选择余地的改善，用来纠正只看收入的发展度量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Economic names the field, development names the unfolding, so the phrase is an economy opening outward.
normal.cn: 经济的一词指领域，发展一词指展开，因此短语是一个经济体向外展开。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as sustainable economic development mark the policy sense.
normal.cn: 可持续经济发展这类固定搭配标出政策义。

normal.en: Growth is more; development is better.
normal.cn: 增长是「更多」，发展是「更好」。

normal.en: The phrase scales from a nation to a county office.
normal.cn: 这个短语可以从一个国家缩小到一个县级的办公室。

normal.en: Structural change is the part that growth alone cannot explain.
normal.cn: 结构变化是单靠增长无法解释的那一部分。

abstract.en: Picture a map being drawn while the road is still being built.
abstract.cn: 想象地图还在画，公路也还在修。

abstract.en: Picture a ladder where the rungs are wages, schools and clinics.
abstract.cn: 想象一架梯子，横档是工资、学校与诊所。

abstract.en: Picture a seed that must change shape before it can grow taller.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗种子必须先变形状，才能长得更高。

examples.en: The province published a five-year economic development plan.
examples.cn: 该省发布了一份五年经济发展规划。

examples.en: Tourism became the main engine of economic development in the islands.
examples.cn: 旅游业成为这些岛屿经济发展的主要引擎。

examples.en: The study asks whether economic development reduced rural poverty.
examples.cn: 这项研究追问经济发展是否减少了农村贫困。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「经济的（economic）+ 发展（development）」——一个经济体产出、结构与生活水平的展开

root: 希腊 oikos「家」+ nomos「法、安排」→ oikonomia「家庭管理」→ economic；古法语 desveloper「解开、展开」→ development。两词在 20 世纪发展政策中连用。nomos 与 desveloper 的词干均不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one economy unfolding: more output, a changed structure, better living conditions, a policy field, a regional programme, a discipline, the long industrial transition, and the debated difference from growth.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个经济体的展开而列：更多产出、结构改变、生活条件改善、政策领域、区域计划、一门学科、漫长的工业转型，以及它与增长之间备受争论的区别。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a four-part chart joined by one arrow, from output to factories to roads to household income.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张四格图由同一支箭头串起，从产量到工厂、到道路、到家庭收入。

branches.en: QUANTITY: the base sense, a sustained rise in output and income.
branches.cn: 数量：基础义，产出与收入的持续上升。

branches.en: STRUCTURE: jobs move from fields to mills, and the historical version of that shift.
branches.cn: 结构：就业从田地移向工厂，以及这一转移的历史版本。

branches.en: LIVING AND PLACE: clinics and schools improve, and the same logic applies to a county.
branches.cn: 生活与地方：诊所与学校改善，同一逻辑也适用于一个县。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS: an office with a budget, and a university department with models.
branches.cn: 机构：一个有预算的办公室，以及一个拥有模型的大学系所。

branches.en: THE DEBATED EDGE: development is not simply more growth but better change.
branches.cn: 争议边缘：发展不只是更多增长，而是更好的变化。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Greek-derived adjective to a French-derived noun, and both parts are highly productive.
intro.cn: 这个短语把希腊来源的形容词与法语来源的名词连在一起，两部分都极有构词力。

latinIntro.en: Greek oikos and nomos build economy and economic; Old French desveloper and the noun suffix -ment build develop and development.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 oikos 与 nomos 构成 economy 与 economic；古法语 desveloper 与名词后缀 -ment 构成 develop 与 development。
