definition_en: the improvement of social conditions and institutions, or the growth of social behaviour and relations over time
core_image: 四个画面并排：新建的诊所、孩子在沙坑里学会轮流、社区议事会、动物幼崽在群体中学习位次
scene: 社区中心的院子里，孩子们排队滑滑梯，老师在一旁数着轮次。Social development begins long before a child can speak about fairness.
sceneCN: 这里 social development 指「儿童社交能力随年龄的发育」（第 1 个义项：社会性的成长）；句意为社会发展远早于孩子能用语言谈论公平之前就开始了。图中可辨识物件：沙坑、滑梯、排队的轮次、社区议事厅、动物幼崽。

pos.zh: 社会发展；社会发育（不可数；指具体进展时可作可数）

senses.title: Growth of a child's social capacity
senses.definition: the gradual development of a child's ability to share, take turns and understand others
senses.definitionCN: 儿童分享、轮流与理解他人能力的逐渐发育
senses.example: Social development begins long before a child can speak about fairness.
senses.exampleCN: 社会发展远早于孩子能用语言谈论公平之前就开始了。
senses.why: in psychology the phrase names a domain of growth alongside physical and cognitive development.
senses.whyCN: 在心理学中，这个短语与身体发育、认知发展并列，指一个成长领域。

senses.title: Improvement of social conditions
senses.definition: better health, schooling, housing and security for a population
senses.definitionCN: 一个人群在健康、教育、住房与保障方面的改善
senses.example: Social development in the district followed the new clinic.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区的社会发展随新诊所而来。
senses.why: the phrase widens from the child to the whole society, where it means welfare rather than behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语从儿童扩展到整个社会，此时指福利而非行为。

senses.title: Evolution of social institutions
senses.definition: the long growth of law, family forms, schooling and public organization
senses.definitionCN: 法律、家庭形态、教育与公共组织的长期演进
senses.example: Social development produced the first public schools in the province.
senses.exampleCN: 社会发展产生了这个省最早的公立学校。
senses.why: institutions are built slowly, so their history is told as a process of development.
senses.whyCN: 制度是缓慢建成的，因此其历史被叙述为一个发展过程。

senses.title: A policy sector
senses.definition: government programmes for health, education and social protection
senses.definitionCN: 政府在健康、教育与社会保护方面的计划
senses.example: The ministry split social development from economic planning.
senses.exampleCN: 该部把社会发展从经济规划中分出。
senses.why: once budgets are assigned to welfare, the phrase becomes the name of an administrative field.
senses.whyCN: 一旦预算被分配给福利，这个短语就成了一个行政领域之名。

senses.title: Community-level improvement
senses.definition: the strengthening of local participation, services and trust
senses.definitionCN: 本地参与、服务与信任的增强
senses.example: Community social development began with a shared meeting hall.
senses.exampleCN: 社区社会发展从一间共用的议事厅开始。
senses.why: the phrase scales down to a neighbourhood, where development is measured in participation.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可缩小到邻里，此时发展以参与度来衡量。

senses.title: The social pillar of sustainability
senses.definition: the social half of sustainable development, beside the economic and environmental halves
senses.definitionCN: 可持续发展中与经济、环境并列的社会一半
senses.example: Sustainability plans list social development beside emissions targets.
senses.exampleCN: 可持续计划把社会发展与排放目标并列。
senses.why: the three-pillar model needed a social term to balance economy and ecology.
senses.whyCN: 三支柱模型需要一个社会项来平衡经济与生态。

senses.title: Growth of social relations
senses.definition: the formation of networks, norms and trust among people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间网络、规范与信任的形成
senses.example: Social development is visible in the denser networks of the town.
senses.exampleCN: 社会发展在这座城镇更密的网络中看得见。
senses.why: relations can grow or wither like other living things, and the phrase treats them as a process.
senses.whyCN: 关系可以像其他活物一样生长或枯萎，这个短语把它当作过程来处理。

senses.title: Social behaviour in young animals
senses.titleCN: 动物幼体的社会行为发育
senses.definition: the development of group behaviour such as rank learning and play in young animals
senses.definitionCN: 幼年动物学习位次、玩耍等群体行为的发育
senses.example: Social development in wolf pups depends on play with adults.
senses.exampleCN: 狼崽的社会行为发育依赖与成狼的玩耍。
senses.why: comparative psychology uses the same phrase for animals, keeping the sense of a growing capacity.
senses.whyCN: 比较心理学对动物使用同一短语，保留「能力在成长」的意思。

intro.en: Social comes from Latin socius 'companion, ally' through socialis; development comes from Old French desveloper 'to unwrap, unfold'. The pairing is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: social 由拉丁 socius「同伴、盟友」经 socialis 而来；development 来自古法语 desveloper「解开、展开」。这一配对属近代用法。年代均为约数。

items.en: Socius meant 'companion, ally'; its deeper origin is not established, and any Indo-European form proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: socius 意为「同伴、盟友」；其更深来源未得到证明，为其提出的印欧形式属重构。

items.en: Socialis described what belongs to companions or allies, and it passed through French into English as social.
items.cn: socialis 指属于同伴或盟友的，经法语进入英语成为 social。

items.en: Desveloper meant 'to unwrap, unfold', from des- 'un-' plus a stem of uncertain origin; its source is uncertain and no reconstruction is offered, while the modern sense of gradual growth comes from that image.
items.cn: desveloper 意为「解开、展开」，由表示「相反」的 des- 加一个来源不确定的词干构成；现代「逐渐生长」义正来自这一意象。

items.en: Nineteenth-century social thought paired the words to name the growth of societies and of social capacities, later split between sociology and psychology.
items.cn: 19 世纪的社会思想把两词配对，命名社会与社会能力的成长，后来分别归入社会学与心理学。

items.en: After 1945 the phrase became a policy label beside economic development, covering health, schooling and welfare.
items.cn: 1945 年之后，这个短语成为与经济发展并列的政策标签，涵盖健康、教育与福利。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origins and first date): the pre-Latin origin of socius is a reconstruction, the stem behind desveloper is unsettled, and the earliest use of the exact phrase is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：socius 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构，desveloper 的词干尚无定论，这一确切短语的最早使用也没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds social compounds that are often substituted without thought; group two holds wider frames of improvement.
note.cn: 第一组是常被不加区分地替换掉的社会类组合词；第二组是更广泛的改善框架。

entries.definition: General improvement with a positive glow; it has no technical measure and no developmental psychology sense.
entries.definitionCN: 带正面色彩的总体改善；没有技术度量，也没有发展心理学义。

entries.definition: Any alteration in social structure or behaviour, for better or worse; development implies improvement.
entries.definitionCN: 社会结构或行为的任何变化，可好可坏；发展则含改善之意。

entries.definition: The system of benefits and services for those in need; it is one instrument of social development.
entries.definitionCN: 为有需要者提供补助与服务的体系；是社会发展的一项工具。

entries.definition: Government rules on welfare, health and education; the phrase names the rules, not the outcome.
entries.definitionCN: 政府在福利、健康与教育上的规定；命名规则而非结果。

entries.definition: Improvement in health, education and choice, often measured by a composite index.
entries.definitionCN: 健康、教育与选择余地的改善，常用综合指数衡量。

entries.definition: Local improvement organized through residents' participation; it is the community-scale branch of social development.
entries.definitionCN: 通过居民参与组织的本地改善；是社会发展在社区尺度上的分支。

entries.definition: The broad turn to industry, science and urban life; social development is one strand within it.
entries.definitionCN: 朝向工业、科学与城市生活的广泛转变；社会发展是其中一条线索。

entries.definition: A bookish synonym for improvement at the level of society; it lacks the psychology sense entirely.
entries.definitionCN: 社会层面改善的书面近义词；完全没有心理学义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的固定搭配与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Social names the group, development names the unfolding, so the phrase is a group capacity growing.
normal.cn: 社会的一词指群体，发展一词指展开，因此短语是一种群体能力在生长。

normal.en: In psychology it sits beside physical and cognitive development.
normal.cn: 在心理学中，它与身体发育、认知发展并列。

normal.en: In policy it sits beside economic development.
normal.cn: 在政策中，它与经济发展并列。

normal.en: In sustainability it forms the social pillar with the economic and environmental ones.
normal.cn: 在可持续性中，它与经济、环境共同构成社会支柱。

normal.en: Fixed phrases such as community social development mark the local scale.
normal.cn: 社区社会发展这类固定搭配标出本地尺度。

abstract.en: Picture a child learning to wait for a turn as a small society forming.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子学会等待轮次，就像一个小社会在形成。

abstract.en: Picture a village meeting hall where trust is built like a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一间村议事厅，信任像墙一样被砌起来。

abstract.en: Picture three pillars holding one roof, marked economy, environment and society.
abstract.cn: 想象三根柱子撑起同一片屋顶，分别写着经济、环境与社会。

examples.en: The school tracks each pupil's social development alongside reading.
examples.cn: 学校在跟踪阅读能力的同时，也跟踪每个学生的社会性发展。

examples.en: The plan links social development with clean water and clinics.
examples.cn: 这项计划把社会发展与清洁用水、诊所联系起来。

examples.en: Researchers observed social development in young chimpanzees.
examples.cn: 研究者观察了幼年黑猩猩的社会行为发育。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「社会的（social）+ 发展（development）」——社会状况与社交能力一同生长，就是社会发展

root: 拉丁 socius「同伴」→ socialis → social；古法语 desveloper「解开、展开」→ development。两词在近代社会学与心理学中分别固定使用。socius 与 desveloper 的词干均不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one growth: a child learning to share, a population gaining health and schooling, institutions evolving, a policy sector, a neighbourhood organizing, the social pillar of sustainability, denser relations, and young animals learning group life.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种成长展开：孩子学会分享、人群获得健康与教育、制度演进、政策部门、邻里组织、可持续性的社会支柱、更密的关系，以及幼年动物学习群体生活。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: four panels side by side, a clinic, children taking turns, a meeting hall and young animals at play.
core.cn: 核心意象：四个画面并排，诊所、轮流玩耍的孩子、议事厅与嬉戏的幼兽。

branches.en: GROWING BEINGS: a child's social skills, and the same learning seen in young animals.
branches.cn: 成长的个体：儿童的社交能力，以及幼年动物身上同样的学习。

branches.en: CONDITIONS: health, schooling, housing and security improve for a whole population.
branches.cn: 状况：整个人群的健康、教育、住房与保障得到改善。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS AND RELATIONS: law and schooling grow, and so do networks and trust.
branches.cn: 制度与关系：法律与教育成长，网络与信任也随之成长。

branches.en: SCALES OF ACTION: a ministry with a budget, and a neighbourhood with a meeting hall.
branches.cn: 行动的尺度：一个有预算的部，以及一间有议事厅的邻里。

branches.en: THE THIRD PILLAR: society placed beside economy and environment in sustainability.
branches.cn: 第三支柱：在可持续性中，社会与经济、环境并列。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin-derived adjective to a French-derived noun, and both halves are productive.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁来源的形容词与法语来源的名词连在一起，两半都很有构词力。

latinIntro.en: Latin socius and socialis build social, society and societal; Old French desveloper and -ment build develop and development.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 socius 与 socialis 构成 social、society 与 societal；古法语 desveloper 与 -ment 构成 develop 与 development。

items.exampleCN: 这个词根指彼此联结的人。

items.example: It turns the noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它把名词变成形容词。

items.example: Social skills are learned in groups.
items.exampleCN: 社交技能在群体中习得。

items.example: Children develop at different rates.
items.exampleCN: 儿童以不同速度发育。

items.example: It turns the verb into a noun of process.
items.exampleCN: 它把动词变成表过程的名词。

items.example: Development takes years, not months.
items.exampleCN: 发展以年计，而非以月计。

items.example: It forms the adjective of growth stages.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示成长阶段的形容词。

items.example: Developmental milestones mark the first years.
items.exampleCN: 发育里程碑标记最初几年。

items.example: It turns the adjective into an adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它把形容词变成副词。

items.example: The pupils are socially ready for group work.
items.exampleCN: 这些学生在社交上已准备好进行小组活动。
